quote.text: People often give us a piece of their mind with the intention to take away our peace of mind.
quote.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Embrace the natural course of emotions in both yourself and your children, understanding that their words sometimes reflect inner turmoil rather than deliberate harm.
    • Nurture inner calm by modeling patience and resilience—acknowledge that the opinions of others should not disturb the serenity of your heart, just as you guide your children to stand firm amid life’s clamor.
  • Leadership
    • Recognize that criticism, even when intended to unsettle, offers an opportunity to practice equanimity and to lead by example through measured response and clear conviction.
    • As a leader, create an environment where honest, constructive dialogue is valued over reactive words, thereby cultivating a community that thrives on mutual respect and steadfast dedication to its mission.
  • Product Management
    • Understand that feedback—especially the harsh kind—is often more about a person’s internal conflicts than the quality of your work; it is a call to remain anchored in your purpose rather than being swayed by external negativity.
    • Use such moments as lessons in resilience, redirecting the energy that might disrupt your peace toward refining your product, guiding it with clarity born of unshakeable inner calm.
